name: openfpga-deck
description: Open-source FPGA development workflow for VS Code, built on YosysHQ OSS CAD Suite.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: OpenFPGA Deck runs FPGA toolchain binaries and writes project files based on fpga.yaml, so it stays inactive until the folder is trusted.

openfpga.toolchain.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to an OSS CAD Suite installation — the folder that contains `bin/` and `environment` (a parent folder that contains `oss-cad-suite/` also works). Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH and common install locations. For security this cannot be set per-workspace.

openfpga.toolchain.installDir.markdownDescription: Directory that holds your OSS CAD Suite installations. **Download Toolchain** puts each release in its own `oss-cad-suite-<tag>/` folder here and keeps the archives under `downloads/`. Defaults to `~/fpga-toolchain`. Usually set via **Download Toolchain**, not by hand.

openfpga.toolchain.keepDownloads.markdownDescription: Keep the downloaded `.tgz` archives (under `downloads/` in the install directory) after extraction. They are large but let you re-install offline. Turn off to delete each archive once its release is installed.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
